<<<EVIDENCE 1 source="prospectus-2026-academic-rules-and-regulations.pdf" section="11. Academic Warning/Probation" page=2 version="2026" status="current">>>
3.74 Cum Laude
11. Academic Warning/Probation
a) At the end of every semester
(including summer semester),
warning is issued if the CGPA of a
student is less than the minimum
required for graduation.
Minimum CGPA required to avoid
academic warning:
BS/BBA programs 2.00
MS/MBA programs 2.50
PhD programs 3.00
218 Prospectus 2026
b) A student on academic
warning needs the approval of
the Head of Department to
register in desired courses.
c) If, after a semester, the CGPA
of a student is less than the
required minimum, the Warning
Count increases by one.
d) If the Warning Count becomes
three, admission of the student in
the University is closed.
e) If after receiving warning,
CGPA improves and equals or
exceeds the required minimum,
the Warning Count is reset to zero.
<<<END 1>>>
<<<EVIDENCE 2 source="academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf" section="5.4 Minimum CGPA required to avoid academic warning is 2.00" page=24 version="2026-06" status="current">>>
5.4 Minimum CGPA required to avoid academic warning is 2.00
for all undergraduate programs.
<<<END 2>>>
<<<EVIDENCE 3 source="grading-page.html" section="Warning/Probation" page=1 version="2026" status="current">>>
Warning/Probation
At the end of every semester (including the first semester and summer semesters), warning is issued provided the CGPA of a student is less than the minimum required for the degree program.
A student with a warning cannot register in a subsequent semester without approval of the relevant Head of Department or any other senior faculty nominated by him.
After each semester (including the summer or the first semester), if the CGPA of a student is less than the required minimum, the Warning Count increases by one.
If Warning Count becomes three, the admission of student at the University is closed.
If the CGPA equals or exceeds the required minimum, the Warning Count becomes zero.
Programs | Minimum CGPA required to avoid Warning
BBA/BS | 2.0
MBA/MS | 2.5
PhD | 3.0
The admission will be cancelled automatically after completion of maximum duration allowed to earn a degree.
<<<END 3>>>
<<<EVIDENCE 4 source="academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf" section="5.6 If CGPA remains below 2.00 for 3 consecutive semesters," page=24 version="2026-06" status="current">>>
5.6 If CGPA remains below 2.00 for 3 consecutive semesters,
warning count becomes three and the admission of student at
the University is automatically closed.
<<<END 4>>>
<<<EVIDENCE 5 source="academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf" section="5.7 If the CGPA equals or exceeds 2.00 after the 1st or 2nd" page=25 version="2026-06" status="current">>>
5.7 If the CGPA equals or exceeds 2.00 after the 1st or 2nd
academic warning, the warning count is reset to zero.
Repeating a Course
<<<END 5>>>
